column1: # YAML blocks in the documentation that belong to another product's
# configuration file rather than to an Antifailure manifest.
# Three tab separated fields: the page, the top level key, and why. A reason is
# required, because an exemption with no argument behind it is
# indistinguishable from somebody silencing a finding they did not understand.
# An exemption that stops being needed is reported, so this list cannot rot.
